channel.title: Planet Zorgon
channel.description: Population: one. Reviews of shit I like, plus a daily log of my miseries, broadcast to whoever's listening.

item.title: Daily Misery: Day 3
item.description:
Why the fuck is the medical centre 1,700 km away from the hostels? People would die before reaching that place.
If Bruce Wayne were Sindhi, he would still be just as rich, but he would be super fat and would always ask Alfred for chai and koki.

item.title: Daily Misery: Day 2
item.description: I sometimes wonder how Spy Kids, a fairly simple kids' movie about kids being spies, suddenly drops one of the most philosophical lines ever: that God stays up there because he might be scared of his own creation. Delivered by none other than Steve Buscemi.

item.title: Daily Misery: Day 1: What a fuckall start
item.description:
I made this website at 2:30 am and at 8:37 my fucking sink fell.
Are these events correlated? Abso-fucking-lutely yes. This is a sign from God.
Or maybe the sign is that I should brush my teeth regularly.

item.title: Game review: Valor Mortis
item.description:
Napoleon and his small dick energy
This game is about what happens if Napoleon was a dictator. I know, shocking, right? It is a first-person Soulslike that works fundamentally fine and is enjoyable at its core. It feels like a mixed dish of BioShock, Soulslikes and a little Dishonored, although the stealth sucks.
The levels stretch on for too long, and the bosses are way too easy, except for a few in the middle that just spike in difficulty. But despite all those issues, it is still fun to kill the French, because fuck the French.
Overall, if you have Game Pass, give this one a try, because…

item.title: Comic review: Batman: Arkham Asylum — A Serious House on Serious Earth
item.description:
Loved it when Joker said "Why so serious" and made out with Batman
At first glance, it looks as if the writers were high on meth and fentanyl and then wrote this on seven cups of coffee per hour. The art style is the epitome of goth and screams Arkham Asylum. It helps you picture how depraved and ugly this place is. On top of that, you have the bloody Joker taking over the place, and things only get worse for Batman.
